verdict.rationale: A public REST API reference exists for the YubiEnterprise service at console.yubico.com/apidocs/, and SDK docs are published. However, nothing shows that this reference is interactive or offers runnable examples, OpenAPI spec paths on docs.yubico.com all return 404, and the docs are described as human-oriented HTML only. Missing for 10: an interactive try-it console, runnable code examples, a published OpenAPI spec, and any hands-on corroboration of interactivity.
